decisions.scenario: Getting the address and phone number for Efes Restaurant

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: I'm looking for a moderately priced Turkish restaurant in the centre of town.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: Efes Restaurant is a moderately priced Turkish restaurant in the centre.

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: That sounds good. Could I have the address and phone number, please?

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: Efes Restaurant is on King Street, City Centre, and the phone number is 01223 500005.

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: Thank you. That's all I need.

decisions.notes: Retained because existing reviewed coverage only identifies Efes Restaurant as a moderately priced Turkish option in the centre; its King Street City Centre address and source-backed 01223 500005 phone number add new durable contact coverage.
